name: visibility-picker
title: Visibility Picker
description: Sharing-level picker where narrowing is instant but widening (a riskier level or more people) shows who gains access and needs an explicit confirm, so a double-click or arrow key can't publish; policy-blocked levels say why, and a failed save restores the old level.

meta.stops: Made a private doc public by accident
meta.summary: Makes widening who can see something an explicit step that shows who gains access; narrowing stays instant.
meta.server: Enforce sharing level and admin policy on the server for every access check.
catches: Widening to a riskier level or a larger audience, held for confirmation
Who gains access, in plain words and counts
Levels blocked by policy, with the reason
Failed saves, reverted with a notice
limits: Audience counts come from your options
The confirm is a UX step; access must be enforced server-side
a11y: Levels are a roving-tabindex radiogroup; arrow keys move focus without applying a widening
Risk level stated as sr-only text; blocked levels use aria-disabled
Widening warning linked via aria-describedby in a polite live region; Escape cancels it
